meta.note: Per-quarter LCA files (Q1–Q4) summed by distinct CASE_NUMBER for FY2020+; annual disclosure files for FY2016–FY2019. Certified H-1B LCAs are filings (Labor Condition Applications), NOT visa approvals; wages annualized.

coverage.source: Wayback Machine archive of OFLC LCA disclosure files: per-quarter (Q1–Q4) files summed by distinct CASE_NUMBER for FY2020+; single annual H-1B disclosure files for FY2016–FY2019
coverage.aggregation: FY2020+ full-year figures are the UNION of DISTINCT CASE_NUMBERs across all four per-quarter LCA files (the quarterly files are per-quarter, not cumulative). FY2016–FY2019 use the annual disclosure workbook.
